title: Исход 24 — Exodus 24
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: Come up to the Lord with Aaron.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward/to) takes the dative → Господу.

cases.translation: …he built an altar at the foot of the mountain.
cases.explain: The noun подножие (foot/base) governs the genitive for the thing it belongs to → горы.

cases.translation: …and with the other half he sprinkled the altar.
cases.explain: Жертвенник is the direct object of окропил (sprinkled); for an inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → жертвенник.

cases.sentence: Он взял ___ завета и прочитал народу.
cases.translation: He took the book of the covenant and read it to the people.
cases.explain: Книга is the direct object of взял (took) → accusative; a feminine -а noun takes -у → книгу.

cases.sentence: Под ___ у него было нечто похожее на помост из сапфира.
cases.translation: Under his feet was something like a pavement of sapphire.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with a location takes the instrumental → ногами (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Моисей тронулся в путь со своим ___ Иисусом.
cases.translation: Moses set out with his helper Joshua.
cases.explain: The preposition с/со (with) takes the instrumental → помощником.

cases.translation: …the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire.
cases.explain: The short adjective подобна (like/similar to) governs the dative → огню.

cases.sentence: Он оставался на ___ сорок дней и сорок ночей.
cases.translation: He remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on/at" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → горе.

reading.ru: Моисей записал все, что сказал Господь.
reading.question: What did Moses do with all the words the Lord had spoken?
options: He carved them into stone at once
He told them only to Aaron
reading.explain: The text states that Moses wrote down everything the Lord had said.

reading.question: How did the people respond to the words of the Lord?
options: They promised to do everything the Lord had said
reading.correct: They promised to do everything the Lord had said
reading.explain: The people answered as one, saying they would do all that the Lord had spoken.

reading.ru: Он послал двенадцать юношей израилетян, и они принесли всесожжение и закололи молодых быков в жертву примирения Господу.
reading.question: What did the young men offer to the Lord?
options: Burnt offerings and peace offerings of cattle
reading.correct: Burnt offerings and peace offerings of cattle
reading.explain: The young men offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings.

reading.ru: Моисей взял половину жертвенной крови и налил ее в чаши, а другой половиной окропил жертвенник.
reading.question: What did Moses do with half of the sacrificial blood?
options: He poured it on the ground
He gave it to the elders
reading.explain: Moses put half the blood into basins and sprinkled the other half on the altar.

reading.ru: Шесть дней облако окутывало гору, а на седьмой день Господь позвал Моисея из облака.
reading.question: On which day did the Lord call to Moses out of the cloud?
reading.explain: The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day God called Moses from it.

reading.ru: Он оставался на горе сорок дней и сорок ночей.
reading.question: How long did Moses remain on the mountain?
reading.explain: The chapter ends by stating Moses stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
